verdict.rationale: mParticle is an API-driven customer data platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack names several APIs (Warehouse Sync API, Audiences, Real-time API) but says nothing about API version numbering, version lifecycle, or a published deprecation policy. Evidence that APIs exist does not show that they are versioned or governed by a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
